title: docs(os-dev): name the signed PR-body trailer as the second HTML-comment exemption
body:
Fixes #34702

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:开发代理说明书(`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`〈干净收尾〉)里「PR 正文不许写 HTML 注释」的例外从一条改成两条,把派发指令要求的末行签名注释正式列为第二条例外。
- 为什么改:说明书禁止开发自己写 HTML 注释,中继脚本却要求 PR 正文最后一行是签名注释,两条规定互相打架,开发每次都要犹豫,审核也可能照说明书挑错。
- 风险与回滚:只改三行说明文字,不动任何代码与门禁;文件行数不变(405 行,正好等于上限)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 第 320–321 行(新例外句);第 323 行(为了不超行数上限,把两条「写完要读回」合并成了一条)。
- 两分钟验证:运行 `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期看到 `.claude/agents/os-dev.md is 405 lines (ceiling 405; headroom 0)` 且退出码为 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One file, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, section 〈干净收尾〉. +3 / −3 lines, 405 → 405 (the ratchet ceiling is 405).

The two texts that conflicted on `origin/main` 4443014630 (in the quotations below, `Fixes #N` stands for the file's angle-bracketed placeholder, spelled out so this body survives the sanitizer):

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:319-320`: "全文 ⛔ 不出现 HTML 注释:sanitizer 落库后吃短尖括号片段,连反引号里的也吃。" and "例外:harness 自写的 PR 正文首行归属注释原样留、只报;`Fixes #N` 紧随其后;dev 自写仍禁。"
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs:871`: "export const PR_BODY_TRAILER_SHAPE = '`<!-- signed: LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION -->`';" and its refusal text at `:957`: "as the LAST non-empty line, alone".

The new exemption sentence (lines 320–321), replacing the old one:

- "例外二:harness 自写 PR 正文首行归属注释原样留、只报,`Fixes #N` 紧随;派发令要求才独占末个非空行写 `<!-- signed: LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION -->`(`PR_BODY_TRAILER_SHAPE`);其余 dev 自写仍禁。"

It names the trailer's exact shape and the constant that owns it, its place (the last non-empty line, alone), and that it is written only when the dispatch order asks for it. Every other dev-written HTML comment stays banned. `dispatch.mjs` is read, not edited.

Paying the line: the new sentence needs two lines under the 120-byte line rule, and the file stood at its ceiling with headroom 0. The line is paid inside the same section by deleting content, not by re-wrapping: the two read-back bullets

- "写完读回那条评论到尾部:只认首行标记保不住正文,sanitizer 可从首个 tag 形片段吃到尾。"
- "PR 正文同欠一次全文回读,评审读的正是它。"

become one: "评论、PR 正文都读回到尾:只认首行标记保不住正文,sanitizer 可从首个 tag 形片段吃到尾。" The obligation (read both the comment and the PR body back to the end) is kept; the clause "评审读的正是它" is dropped. Three words also left the exemption sentence ("的", "其后", and ";" became ",").

## Tests

No behaviour changes; nothing is ablated (documentation only). No package is touched, so there is no build closure and no package test owed.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope addition (a `Requested-by` line before the closing-keyword line): measured, and NOT added. On 4443014630, `git grep -n -i "Requested-by"` over the whole tree answers 0 hits (control: `git grep -n "PR_BODY_TRAILER_SHAPE"` answers 7 lines in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). The spelling `_Requested by **NAME**_` appears in exactly two places, both self-test fixtures (`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:5571`, `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs:746`), as line 2 of the attribution block the harness writes in a project thread. Nothing reads or requires it: `.github/workflows/pr-body-guards.yml` and its four scripts, `.claude/hooks/`, and the relay's `pr_create` (whose header at `dispatch.mjs:477` leaves a pull request body outside the first-line rule) carry no requester rule. The line is harness-written, so the existing first exemption (leave it, report it) already covers it; no gate or ruling in the tree orders a dev to write one.
- The line ratchet prices lines, and this file has no headroom. A later addition to this file needs its own deletion.

## Verification

Head a5865e4174. Derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (23 families); each exit code captured before any pipe.
